briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-frontier AGI competition with China

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny mounts over autonomous agent deployments. Compute shortages persist despite massive new data center investments across US and Middle East.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant; xAI trains Colossus 2 cluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Oracle announce joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas; TSMC begins 2nm AI chip ramp; Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI emerge from a US lab or a state-backed Chinese consortium by 2028?
